infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flyer reads only the photos you pick: a schedule screenshot to add your classes, syllabus pages to add due dates, or a photo to ask Pilot about or send to a friend.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Flyer uses your location while the app is open to sort nearby places by walking time, and, only if you turn it on, to share where you are with friends you choose.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export, and replaces them when you export again.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This lets ads in Flyer be more relevant. Saying no is fine. You'll still see ads, just less relevant ones. Your schedule, location, and friends are never shared with advertisers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only if you turn them on: automatic check-ins stamp campus spots for your flight score after you've spent a few minutes there, and Nearby alerts tell you when a friend who also opted in is close by. Your location only leaves your phone when you're at a check-in place or for a nearby alert. Friends never see where you are.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flyer uses the camera to scan a friend's QR code, and to take a photo you choose to send to Pilot or a friend.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Flyer saves a photo to your library only when you tap Save on it.
